Package neqsim.process.util.optimizer

Class ProcessModelOperatingEnvelopeStudy

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.util.optimizer.ProcessModelOperatingEnvelopeStudy
public final class ProcessModelOperatingEnvelopeStudy extends Object
Samples one- or two-dimensional operating-envelope slices with the existing fail-closed transactional action evaluator.

Every point is a complete action vector evaluated by ProcessModelOperatingActionSetEvaluator. Infeasible candidates remain in the trace when baseline recovery succeeds. Sampling stops immediately when restoration or restored-baseline convergence fails. Leading-bottleneck transitions use only the evaluator's already ranked, finite installed-equipment evidence for feasible points. Infeasible points retain the exact fail-closed rejection source: first the applicable required hydraulic binding, then typed plant/shared/coupled evidence, then the first violated hard registered model constraint in declaration order. Physical values with unlike units are never numerically ranked against each other. Transitions are sampled identity changes, not proof of a continuous boundary, an optimizer active set, or operating approval.

1.0

NeqSim Development Team

    • evaluateOneDimensional

      public ProcessModelOperatingEnvelopeStudy.SliceResult evaluateOneDimensional(String actionId, double[] values, ProcessModelOperatingPointOptimizer.OperatingPointSearchResult search)
      Samples one action around the accepted and replayed point from a compatible mixed operating-point search.

      The search result must retain a feasible, finite, completely evidenced accepted-point replay from the same unchanged evaluator definition. The current process baseline must still be converged and match the replay's captured baseline action values. Validation is read-only and completes before any slice point is evaluated.

      Parameters:
      actionId - exact action identifier
      values - ordered axis values
      search - completed mixed operating-point search
      Returns:
      immutable slice anchored at the accepted replay values

    • getAcceptedPointBottleneck

      public ProcessModelOperatingEnvelopeStudy.LeadingConstraintEvidence getAcceptedPointBottleneck(ProcessModelOperatingPointOptimizer.OperatingPointSearchResult search)
      Reports the leading bottleneck retained by a compatible accepted-point replay without rerunning the model.

      The selected row uses the same unit-safe ranking and exact fail-closed rejection identity as sampled envelope points. A null result means the replay contains no applicable installed or rejecting constraint evidence. This is sampled operating evidence, not a shadow price, causal attribution, global active set, or operating approval.

      Parameters:
      search - completed mixed operating-point search
      Returns:
      immutable leading constraint evidence, or null when no applicable row exists
